transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. Um… I guess what finally made me come in is my focus has been kind of all over the place. I work at the bench, doing jewelry work, and lately I’ll start on a work order, then suddenly I’m checking a customer email, then I notice a saw mark, then some noise outside pulls me away… and then I look back and realize I’ve lost track of the whole order.

It’s probably not as bad as I’m making it sound, but it’s been happening enough that I figured I should ask someone.
How long have you been experiencing these issues with focus? Have they been present since childhood, or did they start more recently?

It’s more recent, I think. I mean, I wasn’t like this as a kid as far as I remember. The really… wired, kind of out-of-control stretch started right after I got that award at the jewelry show, and it went on for about two weeks. I don’t know if that’s the kind of timeframe you mean.
Since the time of that jewelry show award, have you noticed yourself being more restless, needing less sleep, or feeling like you're driven to do more things at once?

Yeah… I mean, I wouldn’t say it was totally out of control, but I was definitely trying to get a lot moving at once. Like right after the award, I started lining up new commissions, messaging old customers, making this whole plan for a website, and sketching out an Appalachian-themed collection… all at the same time.

It felt productive, honestly, like I was finally taking things seriously. But looking back, it was kind of like I had to do all of it right then, if that makes sense.
During that time after the jewelry show award, did you feel unusually high, overly excited, or irritable — like you were on top of the world or had more energy than usual?

Yeah… I guess I did. I felt really lit up after the show, like everything was possible and I was kind of… bigger than usual, if that makes sense. Not in a bad way at first.

But then if someone tried to tell me to keep normal shop hours or slow down, I’d get irritated fast. I snapped at people a couple times, which I’m not proud of. I don’t know if that counts as “on top of the world,” but it was more energy than I normally have.
Would you say that this 'lit up' feeling lasted most of the day, nearly every day, for at least a week?

Yeah… I think so. I mean, I don’t want to overstate it, but it was pretty much most days, most of the day. It started right after that jewelry show award and went on for about two weeks, from what I remember. So… yes, at least a week.
After that two-week period where you felt really energized and productive, did you have a time where you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for several days or more?

Yeah… I mean, I’ve been trying not to make a big deal out of it, but these past couple weeks have been rough. I wake up and it’s like there’s this heavy, hollow feeling there, like the shine’s gone out of everything.

I still get myself to the shop, mostly, but… I’ve cried in my truck before opening up. I don’t know if that’s the kind of thing you mean, but yeah, I’ve felt pretty down.
During that time when you felt down recently, did you lose interest in things you usually enjoy, or feel like you couldn’t get pleasure from them?

I’m… not totally sure how to answer that. I mean, I still do the things I normally do, or at least I try to, so I don’t want to say I’ve completely lost interest.

Maybe it just feels flatter than usual? Like I can’t really tell if I’m enjoying things the same way. Is that what you mean?
How long have you been feeling down or having that heavy, hollow feeling most days?

Um… I guess if I’m being honest, it’s been about a month now. Not every single minute, but most days that heavy feeling is there, and the guilty feeling too. I kept thinking it would just pass, so I maybe didn’t want to count it that way, but… yeah, about a month.

Before this most recent down period, have you ever had a time when you felt so unusually high, full of energy, or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self — even before that jewelry show award?

Before the award? I don’t know if I’d call it “high,” exactly… I mean, I was excited after the show, sure.

But, yeah, after that I did feel kind of lit up, like bigger than myself almost. One minute I’d feel like I could take on anything, and then if someone told me to keep normal shop hours or slow down, I’d snap at them. Not proud of that. I just figured I was riding the momentum, you know? Is that the kind of thing you mean?
Before this current down period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for several days or more?

I don’t think so… not in a way I’d really count, anyway. I’ve had bad days here and there, like anyone, but before this recent stretch I don’t remember being down for several days straight or losing interest like that.

I mean, unless I’m missing something you’d consider important? But nothing really stands out to me.
Before this most recent down period, have you ever had a time when you felt down nearly every day, lost interest in things, or had trouble feeling pleasure for at least two weeks in a row?

No, I don’t think so. Before this last month, I really can’t remember a two-week stretch like that where I was down nearly every day or couldn’t enjoy things. I’ve had off days, sure, but nothing that long that stands out to me… if that makes sense.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least four days where you were so unusually irritable, energetic, or restless that it was a noticeable change from your usual self when you aren’t depressed?

Yeah… I think after the show there was a stretch like that. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was, but I felt kind of lit up, almost larger than life at times.

And then if someone asked me to keep normal shop hours or slow down, I’d get irritated and snap at them. It wasn’t really like me, at least not how I usually am when I’m not down. Does that answer what you mean?
Have you ever had a time when you felt so unusually high, full of energy, or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self — even before the jewelry show award?

Before the award? I don’t think so, no—not anything that clear.

The stretch I’m thinking of was after the show, where I felt kind of… lit up, like bigger than myself one minute, and then I’d get irritated and snap if someone told me to keep normal shop hours or slow down. I’m not proud of that, but that’s the main time it really stood out as different.
Since that time after the jewelry show, have you had three or more separate periods where you felt unusually high, full of energy, or irritable, each time clearly different from your usual self?

Um… three or more separate times? I don’t think I can say that, no. I’ve had days where I’m more wound up or short with people, but not like clear separate periods that stand out the way that one after the show did.

At least, not that I’ve really noticed. Is that the kind of thing you mean?
